Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Karl and Sam <in...@INFOMATCH.COM> write:
> Bunch of Questions
>
> - When tapping a card such as Fragment of the book of Nod, The Barrens,
> or any other card that can be tapped on someone elses turn, when exactly are you
> forbidden from doing so?? (ie. no tapping Heidelburg while in a combat.)

At any time - only Heidelburg has errata limiting its use.

> - Can Pre maneuver cards (such as Skin of Night, Weather Control, etc.)
> be played before Thoughts Betrayed if you are the acting minion??

No. TB comes first.

> - is the damage dealt by a ghoul retainer using a weapon considered to
> be a strike or is it "retainer" damage. and if so can the attack be dodged along
> with the opposing minions strike (ie. with the same dodge?)

Retainer damage - it cannot be dodged.

> - Does the ruling with the interaction of FOM and bum's rush apply if
> the bums rush is blocked by the target of the bum's rush?

? If the action is blocked, it can be continued with superior FoM.
If so, the action continues, and will resolve as normal if it remains
unblocked.

Yes, you can use it to end combat with a blocker and continue a
Bum's Rush action to enter combat, even if it is targetting the
minion who blocked it in the first place.
